listing.name: Gravity Rush Remastered — Gravity Rush for Windows (Prathewsh)
listing.summary: Research project. Experimental research project: neither title has verified Windows gameplay, and a complete native build is not verified. The recorded CMake attempt stopped for missing Vulkan headers/libraries in the macOS development environment; this does not prove every native host build fails. Utility/Python checks do not verify in-game rendering. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own decrypted PS4 Gravity Rush Remastered dump, regional CUSA01113/CUSA01130, containing eboot.bin and sce_sys/param.sfo. No bundled executable patches apply to Remastered; do not inherit GravityRush2 update01.11. Optional audio module libSceNgs2.sprx comes from the owner console. Title/version labels do not verify executable fingerprints.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The project documents Windows packaging and a launcher that prepares your own decrypted game files. The retained evidence does not confirm a completed native build or working game package. One recorded macOS build stopped because Vulkan headers and libraries were missing; that result does not establish whether builds on other systems work.

warnings: Experimental research project: neither title has verified Windows gameplay, and a complete native build is not verified.
